verdict: Client install failed registering `CCM_Service_HostingConfiguration`. WMI returned `WBEM_E_NOT_FOUND` for a class the client.msi expects. Known failure on MP servers after certain cumulative updates.
fix: If the client is being installed on the MP itself: uninstall the management point role, reinstall the client agent via `Ccmsetup.exe /source:'<CM-install>\Client'`, then reinstall the MP role. For a regular client, check WMI health (`winmgmt /verifyrepository`) and ensure `root\ccm` namespace exists; if not, repair with `/salvagerepository` before retrying ccmsetup.
